name: BCF Issue Exchange
description: Write issues (for example QA/QC findings) to a BCF 2.1 .bcfzip file and read a .bcfzip back into a plain issue list. Never changes the Revit model. UNVERIFIED for interop with other BCF tools.
author: AEC Model Bridge

output_path.description: Where to save the .bcfzip file. Must end in .bcfzip and be inside the allowed workspace directories. A relative path is placed in the workspace folder.

issues.description: Issues to export. Each issue may have title, description, status, priority, element_uids (Revit UniqueIds), ifc_guids, author and assigned_to.

use_qaqc_issues.description: Also export the issues recorded by the QA/QC checker for this workspace.

project_name.description: Optional project name stored in the file.

overwrite.description: Replace the file if it already exists.

bcf_path.description: The .bcfzip file to read. Must be inside the allowed workspace directories.
